title: Brand-safe UI screenshot pipeline: redaction, auto-crop, and localization-safe rules
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Problem statement: Our docs and quickstart pages require a steady supply of product screenshots for releases and marketing. Manually cropping and redacting by designers is a bottleneck and error-prone (leaked PII, inconsistent framing, untranslated UI strings visible). Goal: define and implement a brand-consistent screenshot pipeline that automates redaction, cropping to design-safe regions, and enforces localization-safe rules so artifacts are release-ready and audit-friendly.
acceptance_criteria: Automated pipeline produces 3 canonical sizes: hero (1200x600), doc-embed (980x420), thumbnail (420x210) from a single source capture
Redaction engine identifies and masks email-like strings, API keys (regex), and token-like dot-separated strings by default
Localization-safe cropping ensures no truncation of translatable text; screenshots provide 24px safe margins for LTR and RTL locales
Generated assets include metadata JSON (source build SHA, capture timestamp, redaction rules applied) attached to every image
Pipeline integrates with CI (GitHub Actions) and emits artifacts to GCS/Drive with consistent filenames and permission ACLs
technical_notes: Implementation sketch: 1) Single large capture (3840x2160) produced by headless Chromium via a release preview job. 2) Post-process with a small service: a) OCR pass (tesseract) to verify text bounding boxes for localization-safe cropping; b) regex-based redaction pass (emails, uuids, api_key patterns) producing both masked PNG and blurred background variant; c) responsive crop presets that reference component anchors (left-nav, topbar, playground) from a manifest; d) produce metadata JSON and an SRI-style checksum. Deliverables: a Docker image (screenshot-processor:v1) and GitHub Action 'redwood/screenshot-builder@v1'.
decisions: Use headless Chromium over Android emulator because desktop frame is canonical for docs and faster to capture
Redaction will default to mask followed by optional blur if requested via pipeline flag
Store canonical crop manifests in design system repo under /screenshots/crops.json so production changes require design sign-off
tasks: Design: produce crop manifest & safe-margin tokens for hero/doc/thumb (DES task)
Engineering: CI action and GCS upload (ENG ticket TBD)
